task: Audit step 10: measurement and first-visitor comprehension
status: Instrumentation and heuristic review complete locally; analytics activation and real visitor research pending

existing_setup.repository: No analytics integration found before this change
existing_setup.live_page: Reloaded https://deviny.me/ru/ in Chrome; only inline js marker and home.js/product-scenes.js/i18n.js/script.js were present. No client analytics script found.
existing_setup.limits: Does not rule out a private account, CDN/server statistics or a different browser-specific injection. No accessible dashboard was identified.

implementation.rationale: One small local adapter with a strict event schema; no third-party script, identifier storage or runtime framework. An account-specific tracking dashboard is not available, so remote collection remains off.
implementation.hosts: Only https://deviny.me; loopback debug mode never transmits
implementation.privacy: No form fields, contact details, names, message text, dynamic error text, query strings, hashes or referrers. No local/sessionStorage or cookies. DNT/GPC stops collection. When enabled, provider receives IP/User-Agent through normal HTTP, so this is not a claim of no personal-data processing.
implementation.reliability: Best-effort keepalive requests; never delay navigation, retry, block form handling or throw on a blocked collector. Counts can undercount with network failures/ad blockers.

events.name: pageview
events.meaning: Visible page load, once per document
events.caveat: Canonical alias aggregation; not a user identity or installation

events.name: section_seen
events.meaning: A major section intersects viewport at the configured 10% threshold, once per document
events.caveat: Not proof of reading or understanding; non-interactive event

events.name: download_intent
events.meaning: Click on a link to the download block

events.name: store_placeholder_click
events.meaning: Click on an owner-authorized generic storefront link
events.caveat: Pre-release interest only; never install conversion

events.name: store_outbound_click
events.meaning: Click on configured real listing after linksArePlaceholders becomes false
events.caveat: Outbound intent; actual installs require store-side data

events.name: support_attempt
events.meaning: Validated non-honeypot form about to call provider

events.name: support_result
events.caveat: accepted is success:true + successful HTTP; it is not inbox receipt. A timeout is unconfirmed, not proof the email was never sent.

dashboard_plan.pre_release: Report visitors with store_placeholder_click divided by page visitors for the same page/language/time window; do not label this install conversion.
dashboard_plan.post_release: Use visitors with store_outbound_click divided by visitors of the same page/time window; split store, page, language and hero/closing. Keep placeholder data separate.
dashboard_plan.content: Section reach is diagnostic exposure; a lower section may be skipped by an anchor link. Do not treat the sections as a mandatory linear funnel.
dashboard_plan.specialists: Compare home→specialist_interest and store intent on specialist page; contact_interest is a secondary route, not required access.
dashboard_plan.support: Compare accepted/failed/unconfirmed results with attempt event counts (not unique-visitor counts) in the same window; failures warrant investigation.
avoid: No target conversion percentage invented before traffic exists
No decisions from tiny samples or raw click counts alone
No pre/post claims across changed acquisition mix
No claim of improved comprehension from analytics alone
Do not use overlapping section event totals as unique people

comprehension_review.method: Expert walkthrough of current local EN/RU/AZ copy and inspected rendered hierarchy; no participant sessions or synthetic user scores

first_screen_answers.what: The description explicitly calls Deviny a social platform for fitness/sport
first_screen_answers.value: Partners, community and programs connect people with training; the product is not positioned as a tracker
first_screen_answers.audience: People who train; a dedicated route addresses trainers and nutritionists
first_screen_answers.next_step: App Store / Google Play, clearly paired with coming-soon text
first_screen_answers.access: No access request or mandatory specialist selection

paths.audience: Person looking for a training partner
paths.assessment: The three partnership steps explain mutual choice without claiming auto-location.

paths.audience: Person seeking a plan or guidance
paths.path: Programs → author/content/reviews preview → launch limits → FAQ → stores
paths.assessment: Programs and help are distinguishable; paid features are explicitly unavailable at launch.

paths.path: Specialist route → role tools → documents/profile/program preparation → launch limits → stores
paths.assessment: Professional purpose and onboarding are concrete; contacting support is optional.

findings.finding: Download wording currently opens generic storefronts, not the product listing.
findings.decision: Retained exactly as owner requested; separated in measurement. Real listings are required before claiming install conversion.

findings.finding: Program library and review terminology may suggest currently available commerce if a reader skips the launch note.
findings.decision: Observe first-visitor answers before another large copy rewrite; the note and FAQ currently state the limitation.

findings.finding: No evidence that another feature grid, popup, signup gate or animated block improves comprehension.
findings.decision: Preserve approved visual structure; do not reintroduce removed training/chat chapters.

comprehension_review.conclusion: Structure provides a plausible path to future installation and covers key questions. Conversion and comprehension are not yet empirically validated.

participant_protocol.participants: A small first qualitative round: 5–8 people unfamiliar with Deviny, including people who train and at least one trainer/nutritionist. Use their strongest language; include mobile and desktop. This is issue discovery, not population validation.
participant_protocol.moderation: Do not explain the product, point at CTAs or suggest the word social. Record paraphrased answers and task outcomes without names/contact details.

steps.task: Show the first screen for 5 seconds, then hide it.
questions: Что вы сможете с ним делать?
steps.observe: Recall of people/community + sport; tracker-only answers indicate positioning trouble.

questions: Как бы вы нашли человека для совместных занятий?
steps.observe: First click, hesitation, expectations after reading, and whether examples are mistaken for real results.

steps.task: Ask how to start using the product.
steps.observe: Understands coming-soon status and no access gate; record confusion caused by authorized placeholder store buttons.

steps.task: For professionals, find the relevant route.
steps.observe: Understands role, document verification and launch limitations.

steps.task: Ask for final explanation in their own words.
questions: Почему вы выбрали бы это приложение?
steps.observe: Use direct confusion evidence to prioritize the next change.

participant_protocol.decision_rule: Fix task-blocking misconceptions immediately. Repeated confusion across independent participants is a reason to simplify the relevant copy; one subjective visual preference alone is not a redesign brief. Re-test the changed path with new participants.

verification.node: check-analytics.cjs and check-contact-flow.cjs passed without external calls
verification.browser: Chrome local debug confirmed canonical pageview, separate store types/regions, section_seen, support_attempt and accepted result. Dummy form content absent from event payloads.
